title: Plot number field for the allotment ledger (test fixture)
question: Which field style should the ledger use for the plot number?

recommended.reason: a full border is the only one of the three that still reads as a field when it is empty.

options.name: Boxed
options.note: A one pixel border all round with slightly rounded corners; the most familiar.

options.name: Heavy and square
options.note: A two pixel border with square corners; the strongest outline, and the loudest.

options.name: Roomy and round
options.note: More padding and fully rounded ends; the tallest of the three.

context.label: Plot number
context.error: Plot 14B is already in the ledger. Open it, or use another number.
